_doc: Monotone fail-loud ratchet baseline (registry EV-08). Counts UN-waived broad `except Exception` / bare `except:` handlers in non-test src/lawvm/{core,finland} python whose body SILENTLY swallows the error (no re-raise, no named typed diagnostic/finding emit). Per-file 'unwaived' counts may only FALL, never rise; a fall must be committed (regenerate with `uv run python scripts/inventory_control_flow_smells.py --ratchet failloud --update-baseline`). Waive an intentional swallow with `# lawvm-failloud: <reason>`. See tests/test_fail_loud_ratchet.py.
